subject: linkage map with physical distance (bp) in rice

messages.author: 815d8200aa6c9031
messages.subject: linkage map with physical distance (bp) in rice
parts:
Hi!!

I'm analysing SNP data of rice recombinant inbred lines for qtl mapping. When I load my data in R/qtl, I'm getting WARNING:

Some chromosomes > 1000 cM in length; there may be a problem with the genetic map.
  (Perhaps it is in basepairs?)

As I don't have the genetic distance of the markers, Should I proceed with the "bp", instead. 

For rice, what will be ideal approach for QTL mapping, should I need to make the linkage map?

Please suggest.

Thanks, Som

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] linkage map with physical distance (bp) in rice
parts:
For QTL mapping, you need cM locations of markers. You can try using estimates based on the Mbp locations in a physical map, using an estimate of the cM/Mbp ratio.

The warning about chromosomes >1000 cM in length is to avoid a common downstream problem that occurs if the marker map is in basepairs: If you run calc.genoprob with step=1, you'd then try to calculate genotype probabilities at every basepair, which is going to cause memory problems.

karl
